chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Entertain your families every Friday with something of fruit or meat, so that they may rejoice because of Friday.'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended way to treat family members on Friday according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the Prophetic emphasis on cultivating joy (farah) within the family unit, specifically linking the spiritual sanctity of Friday (Yawm al-Jumu'ah) with domestic warmth. In Shia tradition, this act of 'atraf' (treating/enjoying) is seen as a means to strengthen marital bonds and ensure that the day of congregational prayer is also a day of familial celebration, reflecting the balance between worship and worldly happiness.
